title: Ascend shared microbenchmark evidence profile
description: Model-neutral hardware facts and isolated measurements shared by the absolute and SIMD/SIMT route cost models.

$schema.description: Relative path to this JSON Schema; used by editors and validators, not by the cost formula.

schema_version.description: Machine-readable layout version expected by MicrobenchmarkProfile::loadFromJSON.

profile_version.description: Human-readable version of this concrete target evidence set.

target.description: Canonical compiler target for which every measurement in this file is valid.

description.description: Purpose and ownership boundary of the complete shared evidence profile.

measurements.description: Map from stable semantic measurement keys to typed values and their provenance.

measurement.description: One model-neutral hardware fact or isolated measurement with units, scope, provenance, and evidence confidence.

description.description: Human-readable meaning of this measurement and the distinction from similarly named rates.

value.description: Measured or declared numeric value before any cost-model-specific scaling.

unit.description: Physical unit of value; loaders validate the expected unit at each use site.

cycle_domain.description: Clock domain for cycle-based values; required for correct rate conversion.

scope.description: Exact execution scope and workload shape, such as one AIV, warp count, dependency pattern, and working set.

source_kind.description: Evidence category: measured result, device configuration, or architecture contract.

source.description: Reproducible file, command, configuration, or artifact from which value was obtained.

confidence.description: Evidence confidence. This is consumed by Route Model admission and is not a documentation-only comment.
